title: Connector project fragment
description: Project-schema fragment contributed by @jxsuite/connector: the `connections` section naming database connections (identifiers only — secret values never enter project.json) and the `data` section declaring dynamic tables served over /_jx/data.

connections.description: Named database connections. Entries carry identifiers and env-var NAMES only; secret values live in .dev.vars locally and the platform secret store in production (specs/extensions.md §13).

additionalProperties.description: Connection definition. `provider` names a connector class provider id from an enabled extension ("d1", "supabase", "sqlite").

provider.description: Connector provider id (the `connector.provider` of an enabled connector class).

binding.description: Cloudflare binding name for this connection (D1 database binding, or the Hyperdrive binding for postgres providers).

databaseId.description: Cloudflare D1 database UUID (identifier, not a secret).

accountId.description: Cloudflare account id for HTTP-API access (falls back to the CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID env var).

urlEnv.description: NAME of the env var holding the postgres connection URL (e.g. "SUPABASE_DB_URL"). The value itself is a secret and never enters project.json.

hyperdriveId.description: Cloudflare Hyperdrive configuration id fronting a postgres connection from Workers.

file.description: SQLite database file path relative to the project root (defaults to ./.jx/data/<name>.sqlite).

data.description: Dynamic data tables. Each key names a table served at /_jx/data/<name>; rows live in the named connection's database. Schema sync is additive-only (`jx db push`).

additionalProperties.description: Table definition: connection, column schema, id strategy, and permissions.

connection.description: Name of a `connections` entry this table lives in.

schema.description: Column schema. `properties` values are field schemas from the effective project field union (relationship refs included).

properties.description: Column definitions; values are field schemas from the effective project field union.

required.description: Columns every row must provide on insert.

id.description: Primary-key strategy: "uuid" (text ids via crypto.randomUUID) or "integer" (auto-increment).

timestamps.description: Maintain created_at / updated_at columns (ISO 8601 strings set by the data mount).

indexes.description: Secondary indexes: a column name, or an array of column names for a composite index.

permissions.description: Per-action access rules. Defaults: read "public", writes "none". Rules beyond "public" require the auth extension; without it the data mount fails closed.

ownerField.description: Column recording the owning user id — required by "owner" permission rules; set on insert and used to scope owner reads/writes.

PermissionRule.description: Access rule: public | none | authenticated | owner | role:<role>.
